vibe: Emotional, warm, feminine, hope, transformation, empathetic

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight text-[#2C3E50] font-serif leading-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight text-[#2C3E50] font-serif leading-snug

hero_section.structure: Split layout. Left side: Webinar details, emotional hook, value proposition, urgency elements. Right side: Registration form in an elevated card over a subtle gradient/blob background.
hero_section.background: bg-gradient-to-b from-[#F5F1EB] to-white with subtle blurred circular blobs in #8C7A6B and #BFAE9F (opacity-5).

registration_form.structure: White card, rounded-2xl, shadow-xl, p-8. Fields: Name, Email, Phone (using customized Shadcn Input). Submit button taking full width.
registration_form.thank_you_state: Replace form on successful submission. Show a green checkmark, warm thank you message, and a reminder to check email.

urgency_elements.countdown_timer: Flex row of 4 boxes (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds) with text-[#2C3E50] and bg-[#F5F1EB] rounded-lg p-3 text-center.
urgency_elements.spots_remaining: Progress bar showing 39/50 filled (11 left). Text: 'Остават само 11 от 50 места'. Use the progress_bar_fill gradient.

takeaways_section.structure: Bento grid (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with generous gaps (gap-8). Cards have bg-[#F5F1EB], p-8, rounded-2xl. Use Lucide icons (text-[#8C7A6B]) for visual interest.

about_host_section.structure: Image left, text right. Image uses rounded-3xl with a subtle offset background blob. Text explains why Milena is the right guide.

motion_and_interaction.buttons: Transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200. Focus rings should use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#2C3E50].
motion_and_interaction.entrance: Fade in and slide up (using framer-motion if available, or tailwind classes) for sections.

host_photo.usage: Use this photo for the About the Host section and optionally in the hero if it fits.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the landing page at `/webinar` using pure HTML/Tailwind for layout and heavily customized Shadcn components for the form.
Add Playfair Display and Manrope to the project's font setup (e.g., via Google Fonts in index.html).
Implement the form with state management to toggle between the form and the Thank You message after submission.
Create a functional countdown timer pointing to Thursday, July 16, 2025, 20:00 (Bulgarian Time).
Include a progress bar for the limited spots (11 out of 50 remaining).
Ensure all interactive elements and key information blocks have `data-testid` attributes.
Follow the color palette exactly to match the milenapetrova.bg brand.
Keep the tone empathetic and warm. The CTA should say 'Запази своето безплатно място' (Save your free spot).
